title: Preparing for the cold - slow living vlog
en: there is much to be done this time of year as the cold sets in for me there is snow to be shoveled my finicky furnace has needed to be fixed twice this year frost resistant pipes to be checked and a multitude of other little tasks preparing my home for the winter season can be quite time consuming but i reward myself by extending winter preparations to inside my home as well seeing it as getting my little burrow ready for a period of hibernation as you may already know i try my best to

buy everything i can either second hand or make it myself it has been the best decision i made for my finances and for my creativity most of the furniture you see in my home is secondhand sometimes needing only a bit of sandpaper and new coat of paint the same goes for my clothing if i cannot find exactly what i'm looking for i try to get creative with what i already have for example recently i wanted to add some color to one of my walls wallpapers are typically too expensive for my budget so when i came across some cheap vintage wallpaper at a thrift shop i took advantage of it despite it being a bit worn and frayed

do decorating my home for wintertime is always exciting since i know i'll be spending much more time indoors a very wise badger once said no animal according to the rules of animal etiquette is ever expected to do anything strenuous or heroic or even moderately active during the off season of winter this wise saying comes from a

character from the beloved children's book the wind and the willows i think that while i still have to work quite a bit during the winter i like to think this way about the time i do spend at home it is time to enjoy little moments of comfort finish chores around the home and create a space that inspires creativity so

you may be surprised to know that i am someone who is easily distracted and forgetful it has been a struggle for much of my life and at times it still is this part of my person is one of the reasons that i'm attracted to tasks that require concentration and slowness when i can put all my focus on one thing worries and thoughts take a backseat and i'm only there

now absorbed totally in a single thing a seasonal craft i've been meaning to do is make a cinnamon broom it is a popular item i've always seen available in stores during autumn i decided to make my own and decorated the brush after soaking it in cinnamon oil the smell is absolutely magical and it makes me anticipate the holidays do
so in the story from the wind and the willows there is a sweet character named mole who desperately misses his home

after going on an adventure while he enjoys his exciting life above ground traipsing through the fields and forests with his friends rat badger and mr toad his heart aches for the feeling of coming home to a place that is familiar full of coziness and simple welcomes i hope you can create that feeling as well this season be it cold or warm wherever you are i also hope you enjoyed this very simple day at the cottage and i will see you next week with some festive preparations for the holidays have a lovely day or night you
zh: 每年的这个时候，我有很多事情要做，因为寒冷来了，有雪要铲，我挑剔的炉子今年需要修理两次，要检查抗冻管道，还有许多其他的小任务，为我的家准备过冬可能相当耗时，但我奖励自己，将冬季准备工作扩展到我家内部，也把它看作是让我的小洞穴为冬眠做好准备，因为你可能已经知道我尽力了
购买我能买到的所有东西，无论是二手的还是自己做的，这是我为我的财务和创造力做出的最佳决定，你在我家里看到的大多数家具都是二手的，有时只需要一点砂纸和新的油漆，我的衣服也是如此，如果我找不到我想要的东西，我会尝试利用我已经拥有的东西发挥创意，例如最近我想在我的一面墙上添加一些颜色，壁纸通常对我的预算来说太贵了，所以当我在一家商店遇到一些便宜的复古壁纸时旧货店我利用了它，尽管它有点磨损了
冬天装饰我的家总是令人兴奋，因为我知道我会花更多的时间在室内，一只非常聪明的獾曾经说过，根据动物礼仪规则，任何动物都不会在冬季淡季期间做任何艰苦或英勇的事情，甚至适度活跃，这句明智的谚语来自
深受喜爱的儿童读物《风与柳》中的角色 我认为，虽然我在冬天仍然需要工作很多时间，但我喜欢这样思考我在家里度过的时间，是时候享受舒适的片刻了，完成家里的家务，创造一个激发创造力的空间，这样
你可能会惊讶地发现，我是一个容易分心和健忘的人，这在我一生的大部分时间里都是一种挣扎，有时这仍然是我人的这一部分，这是我被需要集中注意力和缓慢的任务所吸引的原因之一，当我可以把所有注意力集中在一件事情上时，担忧和想法退居二线，我只是在那里
现在完全专注于一件事，我一直想做的季节性工艺品是制作一把肉桂扫帚，这是我在秋天的商店里经常看到的一种受欢迎的商品，我决定自己制作并在将刷子浸泡在肉桂油中后装饰它，气味绝对神奇，它让我期待假期
所以风与柳的故事里有一个可爱的人物，名叫鼹鼠，他非常想家
在经历了一次冒险之后，他享受着令人兴奋的地面生活，与他的朋友鼠獾和蟾蜍先生一起在田野和森林中漫步，他的心很痛，因为回到了一个熟悉的地方，充满了舒适和简单的欢迎，我希望你也能在这个季节创造这种感觉，无论你在寒冷还是温暖，我也希望你在小屋里享受这个非常简单的一天，我下周会见到你，为假期做一些节日准备，祝你度过一个美好的白天或夜晚。
